question: Who is the author of the book, 'Walking with the Comrades’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__.

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy is the author of the book, 'Walking with the Comrades’**__.​

 __
 
• Walking with the Comrades (2011) is the eyewitness account of the Naxalite- Maoist insurgency by the Indian author Arundhati Roy.
 
• It is a nonfictional work that describes how the Indian government wages a vicious war against its own citizens.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy**, a resident of Shillong, Meghalaya, was born on 24 November 1961.

 
 
• Roy is best known for his novel The God of Small Things (1997), for which she won the Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997.
 
• Awards: Sahitya Akademi Award (2006), Norman Mailer Award (2011)
